name: fitgap-mock
description: Mock server for the Fitgap API, served directly from the OpenAPI definition.

scripts.test:ci: next build && (next start -p 3000 & echo $! > /tmp/mock.pid) && npx --yes wait-on -t 60000 http://localhost:3000/api/v1/filters && node test/contract.mjs; code=$?; kill $(cat /tmp/mock.pid) 2>/dev/null; exit $code
